node.statement: Validation-gated case discharge: require nodes 1.1 and 1.2 to be validated. Fix any H-CB datum with e<=e_sq, any n>=1, and any Z in M_n tensor S_P. Since e_sq<=e_v and e_sq<=e_ca, either P is nonvanishing, in which case validated node 1.2 yields ||Z^dagger dot Z|| >= (1-C_ca*e)||Z||^2 = (1-K_sq*e)||Z||^2, or P is not nonvanishing, in which case validated node 1.1 yields S_P={0}, hence Z=0 and the same inequality reads 0>=0. These complementary cases establish the asserted estimate for all n and Z.
